name: video-pip
note: ROUND 18 CONTRACT (S-FIRSTSESSION-TAP-BLOCKED, resolved 2026-09-05 - PR #342 merged). THE MINI PLAYER DOCKS THE VIDEO TO A CORNER PIP; THE OPEN STUDIO SHEET KEEPS THE FULL THEATER. This scenario previously pinned 'a fresh device shows the video VISIBLE on a MINI player' as the THEATER card, and that contract shipped a severe defect: the theater is position:fixed top:58, 245px tall, z-96 - a placement sized for an OPEN sheet. On a mini player it pinned the iframe over the top ~300px of EVERY tab, so after any row-tap play the library, Compose and Tune silently ate taps there (measured: elementFromPoint over a Compose progression pick returned IFRAME). minimizeStudio() now demotes a theater to the PIP dock, which is what setVid's own stash comment had claimed since round 11 while no code did it. MEASURED state machine (412x915, this is the contract): PIP = player has NO vid class, media .min, 152x110 fixed at (top 655, left 250), z-95, handles [data-thmax] + [data-piphide] live, menu reads 'Expand video'. THEATER = player .vidopen, media bare, 392x245 fixed at (top 58, left 10), handles [data-thmin] + [data-thdock] live, menu reads 'Hide video'. PARKED = player .vidhid, media .hid, zero-box, no handles, menu reads 'Show video'. Transitions: fresh row-tap play -> PIP (and writes NO preference - restoring a default must never masquerade as a user choice); PIP +thmax -> THEATER (pref theater); THEATER +thmin -> PARKED (pref hid); PARKED +left-zone -> THEATER (pref theater); THEATER +thdock -> PIP (pref pip); PIP +piphide -> PARKED (pref hid). Opening the STUDIO SHEET shows the THEATER (pref untouched) - the big skip surface lives where it was sized to fit. ROUND 16 REMAINS THE GOVERNING LAW (verbatim: "don't auto hide yt video. I keep having to open it to skip after ads"): THE APP NEVER HIDES THE VIDEO ON ITS OWN. There is no auto-minimize timer and no countdown. The video is visible on a fresh play - as the corner PIP on a mini player, as the theater in the open sheet - and one tap ([data-thmax]) reaches the full-size skip surface. Parking is a REMEMBERED USER CHOICE (music.vidPref.v1, additive), never something the app does for you. Why the reversal history matters: twice an automatic hide trapped the operator inside an ad - a 7s wall-clock collapse (2026-07-31), then round 15's open-PARKED default which silently undid that mitigation. The ad boundary is undetectable cross-origin, so no timer can be tuned safely around it. ONE element, the iframe never remounts (audio never dies). Plus: continuous playerState sync (the field rides every infoDelivery tick), scrub with touch-action:none, and refocus honesty. Native requestPictureInPicture is unreachable for a cross-origin YT iframe - this PIP is an overlay by design. THE TAP-EATING GUARD BELOW IS THE POINT OF THIS SCENARIO: revert the one _setVid('pip', true) call in minimizeStudio and it goes red.

steps.label: ROUND 18 - ROW-TAP PLAY on a FRESH device docks the video to the CORNER PIP: visible (round 16 - the app never hides it) but 152x110 in the bottom-right, not a 392x245 card pinned over the page. No preference is written - restoring a default must not masquerade as a user choice.
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('mini'))return false;if(p.classList.contains('vidopen')||p.classList.contains('vidhid'))return false;var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('min')||m.classList.contains('hid'))return false;if(getComputedStyle(m).position!=='fixed')return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>130&&r.width<170&&r.height>90&&r.height<120))return false;if(!(r.top>window.innerHeight*0.6&&r.left>window.innerWidth*0.5))return false;var f=m.querySelector('iframe');if(!f||!/\/embed\//.test(f.src))return false;window.__pipFrame=f;try{if(localStorage.getItem('music.vidPref.v1')!==null)return false;}catch(e){return false;}return true;})()

steps.label: TAP-EATING GUARD (the defect this contract exists to prevent): after a row-tap play NOTHING covers the top of the page - elementFromPoint down the centre line from y=60 to y=320 must never return the IFRAME, on the library AND on every other tab. Under the old theater-on-mini contract this returned IFRAME across ~300px of every tab.
steps.js: (function(){function scan(){var bad=[];for(var y=60;y<=320;y+=20){var e=document.elementFromPoint(Math.round(window.innerWidth/2),y);if(e&&e.tagName==='IFRAME')bad.push(y);}return bad;}if(scan().length)return false;var tabs=['compose','tune','library'],ok=true;tabs.forEach(function(t){var b=document.querySelector('.tabbar button[data-tab='+t+']');if(b){b.click();if(scan().length)ok=false;}});return ok;})()

steps.label: the PIP's top bar EXPANDS to the theater - the full-size skip surface is one tap away (round 16: Skip must be reachable). Theater geometry: 392x245 fixed near the top, park + dock handles live, menu flips to Hide video, and the choice is remembered as 'theater'.
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('vidopen')||!p.classList.contains('mini'))return false;var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||m.classList.contains('min')||m.classList.contains('hid'))return false;if(getComputedStyle(m).position!=='fixed')return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(Math.abs(r.width-392)<4&&r.top>40&&r.top<120&&r.height>200))return false;if(m.querySelector('iframe')!==window.__pipFrame)return false;var h=document.querySelector('[data-thmin]'),d=document.querySelector('[data-thdock]');if(!h||h.getBoundingClientRect().height<14)return false;if(!d||d.getBoundingClientRect().height<14)return false;var vt=document.querySelector('[data-vidtoggle]');if(!vt||vt.textContent.trim()!=='Hide video')return false;return localStorage.getItem('music.vidPref.v1')==='theater';})()

steps.label: the theater's down-arrow PARKS it - no intermediate docked step (round 15 operator ask, verbatim). Media zero-box, player .vidhid, the SAME iframe still mounted (audio alive), the title wears the cue, no video chrome, and parking is remembered as a user act.
steps.js: (function(){var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('hid')||m.classList.contains('min'))return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width<2&&r.height<2))return false;var f=m.querySelector('iframe');if(f!==window.__pipFrame||!f.isConnected)return false;var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('vidhid')||p.classList.contains('vidopen'))return false;var cue=getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.bt-st-t'),'::before').content;if(!cue||cue==='none')return false;var hidden=['[data-piphide]','[data-thmax]','[data-thmin]','[data-thdock]'].every(function(s){var e=document.querySelector(s);return !e||e.getBoundingClientRect().height===0;});if(!hidden)return false;return localStorage.getItem('music.vidPref.v1')==='hid';})()

steps.label: LEFT-ZONE tap on a parked mini player goes straight back to the THEATER (the skip surface), not to the PIP - showing it again is a user act and is remembered as 'theater'.
OPT-IN dock: the theater strip's corner chip is the way into the small PIP - docked above the now-playing bar, maximize bar on top, park tab flush on its left, same iframe, remembered as 'pip'.
steps.js: (function(){var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('min'))return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>130&&r.width<170&&r.height>90&&r.height<120))return false;var bar=document.querySelector('.bt-st-head').getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.bottom<=bar.top+2))return false;var tx=document.querySelector('[data-thmax]');if(!tx||tx.getBoundingClientRect().height<14)return false;var h=document.querySelector('[data-piphide]');if(!h)return false;var hr=h.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(hr.right<=r.left&&r.left-hr.right<3))return false;if(m.querySelector('iframe')!==window.__pipFrame)return false;return localStorage.getItem('music.vidPref.v1')==='pip';})()

steps.label: the PIP's flush left tab parks it - same end state as every other dismiss, same iframe, remembered as 'hid'.
SCRUB (parked, in mini): the track owns its touches (touch-action none - the browser must never reclaim the drag for panning); synthesized duration, pointer-drag to ~60%, fill lands at 60

PLAYERSTATE SYNC: pausing inside the embed must flip the bar - a synthesized infoDelivery tick carrying playerState 2 flips to Play + npPaused, and playerState 1 flips back (the field rides every tick, so missed delta events cannot leave the bar lying)
REFOCUS HONESTY: a visibility return while marked playing flips the bar to PAUSED - backgrounding always pauses the embed, the bar must never lie
the STUDIO DOOR opens idempotently - same iframe, video STILL parked (the remembered choice holds through navigation), menu offers Show video
in the OPEN STUDIO the left-zone toggle gives the THEATER, not the PIP - the sheet is where the big card was sized to fit, so the full skip surface lives here

LEAVING THE STUDIO WITH THE THEATER OPEN DEMOTES IT TO THE PIP - this is the fix itself: the card sized for the sheet must not follow you onto the page. Same iframe (audio never dies), and the top of the page is clear again.
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('mini'))return false;var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('min'))return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>130&&r.width<170&&r.height>90&&r.height<120))return false;var f=m.querySelector('iframe');if(f!==window.__pipFrame||!f.isConnected)return false;for(var y=60;y<=320;y+=20){var e=document.elementFromPoint(Math.round(window.innerWidth/2),y);if(e&&e.tagName==='IFRAME')return false;}return true;})()
